newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Kumaratunga says the government will take action against public servants who intentionally sabotage government programmes. The president was speaking at the inauguration of performance appraisals for the public sector, which is part of the government's public sector reforms programme.
Date for nominations for local government elections to be held this year, to be announced next week. Elections will be held in all local governments, except those in northeast.
President Kumaratunga tells public servants, government will not hesitate to take action against those not performing their duties.
Police arrest Tamil separatist rebel sent to assassinate Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadiragamer, and Justice Minister G.L.Peiris.
Sri Lanka Telecom to raise charges by 40 percent, from February.
Government to build new hospital which will compete with private medical institutions.
